I didn’t take issue when Trump didn’t put his hand on the Bible during his swearing-in 16 months ago.

In fact for 15 months I kept quiet about it.

But on month 16 when I disagreed with his recent moves I decided to call him out for the Bible thing because I am consistent.

My take on The View hosts suddenly flipping the script when it’s Eric Swalwell facing sexual allegations:

Video

The new thing: 

“Wow Trump falsely claims God chose him to expose satanic demonic child sacrificing monsters.

25th now!”
Watched many reviews, @homegymcoop’s sealed the deal.
I’d rather see Trump depicted as Jesus in a meme than some fat lesbian
The moment Trump posted that distasteful meme of himself as Jesus Christ, my Christian ethics, many of which I don’t follow, suddenly became my weapon and placed me on the moral high ground.

In his second term so far, Trump, who just mocked Christians by reposting a meme of himself as Jesus Christ, has:

- Created a task force to eradicate anti-Christian bias.

- Established the Religious Liberty Commission.

- Pardoned Christians prosecuted under the FACE Act.

- Ordered guidance to safeguard the right to pray in schools.
This was long overdue

Your criticism of the war and the Epstein files doesn’t suddenly make you 

- Amplify every negative Trump story.

- TYPE ENTIRE POSTS IN ALL CAPS when bashing him.

- Frame questions about Trump as statements.

- Pretend to read his mind.

You got something else going on.

The Tolerant Left

Video

After further consideration, I’ve decided to take back my statement. 
I’m sorry to everyone who was personally offended or affected by my words.

Video
